online_inputs_file: branches/inputs/<scene>.npz, arrays named t<checkpoint>_<field>; written once per snapshot before any continuation is run

online_inputs.rgb_history: uint8 [obs_horizon, H, W, 3 x cameras]; cameras in sorted name order, exactly what the policy receives
online_inputs.state_history: float32 [obs_horizon, D]; qpos, qvel, tcp_pose (the whitelist of src/hci/schema.py)
online_inputs.queue: float32 [n, 4]; unexecuted commands of the current chunk
online_inputs.policy_feature: float32; fixed encoder output of the frozen policy for the same history, + last action, t/horizon, queue fraction

diagnostic_privileged_only.scene JSON: initial_state, snapshots[].s: cube poses, grasp/on-cube/static flags, stage labels read from simulator ground truth
diagnostic_privileged_only.branches/traces/<scene>.npz: per-step TCP, cube positions, flags, success, executed action

rule: Nothing of the second group is written into the online input file, and none of it is given to the policy. No model was trained in this stage.
